observations: Photo 0: Close-up of a dark grey/black office copier body wrapped in clear plastic film, with cardboard sheet laid on top; 'KONICA MINOLTA' logo visible on left side and 'bizhub 223' nameplate visible on right side.

Photo 1: Wider view of the same machine from the front-left, showing the full body including paper drawers, scanner/document bed lid lifted, and side control panel area; 'KONICA MINOLTA' and 'bizhub 223' labels visible on the front panel.
Machine is entirely wrapped in plastic film, consistent with a shipped/warehouse unit rather than an in-use office setup.
No power cable connected, no screen/display lit, no printed output, no usage counter or toner level visible in either photo.
Watermark 'SMATECH MEGA EQUIPMENT' overlaid on both photos, indicating a reseller/dealer listing photo, not an independent buyer-taken photo.

claims.evidence: No import documents, shipping labels, or usage history visible in either photo; cannot confirm origin or prior location from images alone.

claims.claim: provide complete office communication functionality and print
claims.evidence: Generic marketing description; no photo shows the unit powered on, printing, scanning, or faxing.

claims.claim: Implied working condition (by omission, since listed for sale)
claims.evidence: Machine is shown wrapped and idle in both photos; no power-on screen, test print, or usage counter shown.

risks.risk: Machine may not power on or may have internal faults (common with used copiers)
risks.proof: Video or photo of unit powered on with control panel screen lit, plus a sample test print/copy

risks.risk: High page/usage count (copiers are often priced by meter reading, heavy use lowers value)
risks.proof: Photo of the service/usage counter screen from the control panel menu

risks.risk: Missing or low toner/drum unit, or drum near end of life
risks.proof: Photo of opened toner/drum compartment showing consumable levels and part condition
risks.if_unproven: priced as needing full consumable replacement

risks.risk: Hidden physical damage (cracks, broken trays, scanner glass scratches) concealed by plastic wrap
risks.proof: Clear unwrapped photos from all four sides plus open scanner lid and open paper trays
risks.if_unproven: priced as cosmetic condition unknown, assume moderate wear

risks.risk: Missing accessories (power cable, drum unit, trays, manuals) not shown in frame
risks.proof: Full unwrapped photo showing all trays extended and accessories laid out beside unit
risks.if_unproven: priced as bare unit only, accessories not included

risks.risk: 'London use' claim could be an unverifiable grading label with no bearing on actual condition
risks.proof: Photo of any import/customs sticker or original UK dealer tag on the unit
risks.if_unproven: treated as unverified claim, no premium applied

proof_requests: Video of the unit powered on, showing control panel boot screen and a live test copy/print
Photo of the internal usage/meter counter from the panel menu
Photo of the opened toner and drum compartments showing consumable condition
Unwrapped photos from all sides and with trays open, showing no physical damage
Photo of any accessories included (power cable, manuals, extra trays)
response.reason: The item is clearly identified as a Konica Minolta bizhub 223 copier from legible nameplates in both photos, but it is shown wrapped and idle with no proof of power-on, print output, or usage history, so it must be priced at worst case as an unverified/untested unit pending the listed proofs.
